scope: Paper 37, Normalbasis bei Koerpern ohne hoehere Verzweigung, Journal fuer die reine und angewandte Mathematik 167 (1932), printed pp.147-152.

checked_loci: Printed p147 Deuring footnote: visual source confirms product factors rather than quotient-looking factors.
Printed p150: visual source confirms parenthetical rationalen and semicolon in the determinant formula line.
Printed p151 footnote 10: visual source confirms ordinary P notation in the hypercomplex coefficient extension line.
patch_summary: Deuring footnote changes four Fuehrer factors from quotients to products.
Restores source parentheses around einseitigen, isomorphen, and rationalen.
Changes section 1 opening base-order notation from frakO to frako.
Changes D formula punctuation from comma to source semicolon before S,T in G.
Changes footnote 10 notation from mathfrak P to ordinary P in (K_p)_P and related line.
Adjusts Satz 7 prime-ideal prose from indexed prose to the source's unindexed prose line.
quality_label: Source-backed P37-local working repair candidate; not whole-Paper-37 certification, not whole-corpus certification, not critical edition, and not multilingual synchronization.
open_items: Reconcile this P37 patch with any later R126/R127 German cumulative branch before public promotion.
Run a full line-by-line P37 audit if this patch becomes the canonical branch; the package has source crops and a compile gate but no independent line-by-line audit ledger.
Propagate accepted German P37 fixes to English and multilingual branches only after the German branch is frozen.
